candidates.hypothesis: For proposal-eligible contexts, a content-bearing proposal changes the recipient's ballot beyond changes caused by matched-length neutral text and formatting.
competing_explanations: Observed ballot variation is caused by prompt length, salience, or serialization rather than proposal meaning.
Shared incentives and common knowledge of the rewarded target explain matching behavior without communication.
